name: u1-base-resonance-tester
title: U1 Base: resonance tester
author: bespoked
description:
Part of the U1 Base Layer. It brings the printer's resonance measurement up to date with newer Klipper code, so input shaper calibration measures what the printer really does.

What changes:
• TEST_RESONANCES can use an accelerometer other than the stock one, and its acceleration per hertz can be set from the command.
• A gentler sweeping vibrations test runs alongside the pulse test.
• The sweep uses the frequency range the printer is set up for instead of a fixed one.

Install this because a plugin you want asks for it. Under the hood it edits Klipper's own program files on the printer. Uninstalling puts the originals back, and it re-applies itself after a firmware update. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Newer Klipper resonance measurement, for more accurate input shaper calibration.
